developments.note: Use the internally consistent May 2024 decision-report revision: 632 total minus 8 removed = 624 net. Pipeline snapshot says 630; preserve that conflict rather than combining revisions. Future site delivery is unobserved.
June 2026 report describes a sales centre and surface parking on the current site. Zero current homes is derived from that description, not the earlier whole Regent Park demolition programme.

Consultation confirms 1,197 proposed units but not the existing residential count. Zero existing homes remains an assumption requiring current application review, not a confirmed net-new total. Historical report downloads returned 404 and are not relied on.

evidence.household_size: 2021 neighbourhood mean transferred to each building: assumption, not observed building occupancy
evidence.existing_occupied_share: Assumed transfer: 1 minus CMHC 2025 Toronto CMA purpose-built vacancy of 3%; not an observed building rate, especially for social housing. Expanded condos and small homes also use this explicit scenario proxy; regional rental vacancy does not measure their occupancy.
evidence.new_occupied_share: Assumed future fully occupied phase; no completion date or current occupancy claim.
evidence.transit_share: Assumed transfer of TTS 2022 Ward 13 resident-trip AM share including GO-only and GO+transit; not specifically 505 or westbound.
evidence.trips_per_resident_in_window: Assumed uniform transfer from TTS 06:00-09:00 to 07:00-09:00 using factor 2/3.
evidence.link_travel_times_s: GTFS schedule differences as proxy; may include dwell. Do not add another dwell component without correcting for overlap.
evidence.streetcar_capacity: TTC physical maximum 251 (70 seats + 181 standing). Historical planned loading is 130, not the same quantity.
evidence.headway_s: Arithmetic mean of adjacent dated GTFS entry gaps, not median or observed reliability.
evidence.arrival_variability: Regular headways and uniform passenger arrivals are assumptions; seed is internal.

observed_passenger_demand.geography: whole route, both directions, all day

unresolved: Every complete, valid OSM building footprint in the cached corridor tiles within 500m of a stop; not a guarantee every physical building is mapped. Unknown-use buildings have conditional estimates but are not silently treated as homes.
No observed stop/direction/time-window boardings or incoming load were found. Do not scale whole-route daily boardings into this segment without an explicit model.
transit_share is all transit; the owner must agree corridor/direction/destination assignment before interpreting generated riders as 505 demand.
Walking paths use estimated connectors; legal crossings, entrances and closures remain unverified. Network access is not field sign-off.
761 existing-unit replacement is assumed zero. 239 report and pipeline versions disagree; the chosen report revision is explicit.
The default reporting cap is 09:00, the end of passenger arrivals. Late cars/riders may remain unresolved; the simulation owner must choose and record a clearance rule.

Unpublished residential unit counts are estimates with broad assumed ranges; unknown building use, podium/storey ambiguity and conflicting posted figures require review. OSM geometry matches cannot verify legal units.

existing_residences.meaning: Published city/developer/OSM counts where available; missing residential counts estimated from local footprint/storey calibration. Per-building source, method, range and inclusion are in building_unit_inventory.json. Occupancy and travel shares remain transferred assumptions.

developments.meaning: See per-project revision and replacement-count reconciliation. Future occupied share is an assumption, not today's occupancy.

link_travel_times_s.meaning: Scheduled stop-time differences may include dwell; not an observed movement-only measure.

streetcar_capacity.meaning: 251 is the physical maximum. Historical TTC planned loading is 130; the owner can model a lower effective cap explicitly.

headway_s.meaning: Mean of successive entry gaps; not the 360-second median and not observed service.

rush_hour_duration_s.meaning: 07:00-09:00 Toronto time on the selected GTFS service date.

end_time_s.meaning: 09:00 local is 32400 seconds. This is an explicit reporting cap; late vehicles remain unresolved unless the owner extends it.

trips_per_resident_in_window.meaning: Resident-trip AM survey total divided by resident population, then multiplied by 2/3 under a uniform-within-3h assumption.

headway_randomness_s.meaning: Zero retains regular entries; this is not measured variability or a standard deviation.

link_travel_time_variation_share.meaning: Zero keeps fixed link times. This control is not an observed variation estimate or standard deviation.

commuter_distribution.meaning: A single bin assumes uniform arrivals over the window.

seed.meaning: Reproducible random seed; not real-world data.

westward_share.meaning: Share of generated commuters given a workplace west of home; the rest are placed anywhere else. Uncalibrated; employment locations alone do not establish commute direction.

walk_limit_m.meaning: Longest walk to work, to a useful Line 1 station or to/from a 505 stop. Walking distance is straight-line distance times the reviewed detour factor.

parallel_route_bands.unit: fraction of the distance from Dundas to College/Carlton (north) or Queen (south)
parallel_route_bands.meaning: Below the first value all commuters consider the 505; up to the second, half do; beyond it they are assumed to use the 506 or 501 and leave the model.

incoming_load_range.unit: passengers already aboard per car at Broadview & Dundas
incoming_load_range.meaning: Each car entering the segment draws its starting load uniformly from this range. No observed incoming occupancy exists; this is the input most likely to change who is left behind.
incoming_load_range.sensitivity_note: Proposed range for sensitivity runs. The high case tops out at TTC's historical planned load of 130; it is not an observation.

stop_dwell_range_s.meaning: Each stop's dwell is drawn uniformly from this range. Scheduled link times may already include some dwell, so this can double count.

summary.coverage: Every complete, valid OSM building footprint in the cached corridor tiles within 500m of a stop; not a guarantee every physical building is mapped. Unknown-use buildings have conditional estimates but are not silently treated as homes.
